from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/105-24/1_105-24_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/105-24_0_2d43c315/1_105-24_output.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws_open = wb["Open"]
ws_prod = wb["Productivity"]

# Build a dynamic ID -> Name mapping from all currently populated rows in Productivity!A:B.
id_to_name = {}
for row in range(1, ws_prod.max_row + 1):
    mud_id = ws_prod.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    name = ws_prod.cell(row=row, column=2).value
    if mud_id is None or name is None:
        continue
    mud_id_str = str(mud_id).strip()
    name_str = str(name).strip()
    # Skip header/title-like rows and only map plausible ID/name pairs.
    if not mud_id_str or not name_str or mud_id_str.lower() in {"mud id", "p r o d u c t i v i t y"}:
        continue
    id_to_name[mud_id_str] = name_str

# Only modify the allowed answer range: 'Open'!C2:C23.
for row in range(2, 24):
    cell = ws_open.cell(row=row, column=3)
    if cell.value is not None:
        key = «redacted»        if key in id_to_name:
            cell.value = id_to_name[key]

wb.save(output_path)

# Verification: print the values in the permitted output range.
wb_check = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=True)
ws_check = wb_check["Open"]
for row in range(2, 24):
    print(f"C{row}: {ws_check.cell(row=row, column=3).value}")
